```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="definitions"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">

  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="RestaurantPool" name="Restaurant" processRef="RestaurantProcess" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="RestaurantProcess" isExecutable="false">

    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Restaurant">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Guest" name="Guest">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Event</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterRestaurant</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseDish</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitTurn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickupMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EatMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Success</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterOrderPOS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectMoney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetupBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InformChef</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RingBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandOverMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CallGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Chef" name="Chef">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceInHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InformEmployee</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Events -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Event" name="Guest enters restaurant (hungry)" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Success" name="Process completed (guest ate)" />

    <!-- Guest tasks -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterRestaurant" name="Enter restaurant" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseDish" name="Choose a dish" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitTurn" name="Wait for turn" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with employee" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickupMeal" name="Pick up meal at service hatch" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EatMeal" name="Eat meal" />

    <!-- Employee tasks -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterOrderPOS" name="Enter order into POS system" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectMoney" name="Collect money from guest" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetupBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer and give to guest" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new order" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RingBuzzer" name="Ring guest's buzzer" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal to guest" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CallGuest" name="Call guest after 5 minutes (repeat if needed)" />

    <!-- Chef tasks -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare the meal" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceInHatch" name="Place meal in service hatch" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformEmployee" name="Inform employee that meal is ready" />

    <!-- Gateway for guest reaction -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GuestReact" name="Guest reacts to buzzer?" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow1" sourceRef="Start_Event" targetRef="Task_EnterRestaurant" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow2" sourceRef="Task_EnterRestaurant" targetRef="Task_ChooseDish" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow3" sourceRef="Task_ChooseDish" targetRef="Task_WaitTurn" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow4" sourceRef="Task_WaitTurn" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow5" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_EnterOrderPOS" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow6" sourceRef="Task_EnterOrderPOS" targetRef="Task_CollectMoney" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow7" sourceRef="Task_CollectMoney" targetRef="Task_SetupBuzzer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow8" sourceRef="Task_SetupBuzzer" targetRef="Task_InformChef" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow9" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="Task_PrepareMeal" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow10" sourceRef="Task_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Task_PlaceInHatch" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow11" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInHatch" targetRef="Task_InformEmployee" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow12" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployee" targetRef="Task_RingBuzzer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow13" sourceRef="Task_RingBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_GuestReact" />

    <!-- Guest reaction branches -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_yes" name="Yes"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_GuestReact" targetRef="Task_PickupMeal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
          xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">guest reacts</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_no" name="No"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_GuestReact" targetRef="Task_CallGuest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
          xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">guest does not react</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Loop back after calling guest -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_loop" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Gateway_GuestReact" />

    <!-- Continue after guest picks up -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow14" sourceRef="Task_PickupMeal" targetRef="Task_HandOverMeal" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow15" sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Task_EatMeal" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow16" sourceRef="Task_EatMeal" targetRef="End_Success" />

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
```

We need to produce BPMN XML model fulfilling requirements. Steps: need pool for organisation, lanes for each actor. Actors: guest, employee, chef, POS system? The POS system is a system. Also maybe "service hatch" is object, not lane. So lane per actor: Guest, Employee, Chef, POS System (maybe as lane). Use exclusive gateways for decisions: There's a decision: guest reacts to buzzer? If not, employee calls after 5 min, possibly repeat. That's a loop with decision.

Also need start event and end events for each path. Paths: success (guest reacts) leads to meal pick up and eat, then end. If no reaction, employee calls, repeat until guest reacts? May model as loop with exclusive gateway: after buzzer ring, wait for guest pickup. Use exclusive gateway: "Guest picks up meal?" yes -> handover and end. No -> call after 5 min -> repeat? Could be a loop back to start of waiting? Let's model.

Sequence:

Start event (Guest enters hungry) -> Guest chooses dish -> Guest waits (maybe a task?) but we can model as task "Wait for turn". -> Guest places order with employee (task). -> Employee enters order into POS system (task). -> Employee collects money (task). -> Employee sets up buzzer and gives to guest (task). -> Employee informs chef (task). -> Chef prepares meal (task). -> Chef places meal in service hatch (task). -> Chef informs employee (task). -> Employee sets off buzzer (task). -> Guest receives buzzer signal (perhaps implied). -> Exclusive gateway: "Guest picks up meal?" -> Yes: Guest picks up meal (task) and eats (task) -> Employee hands over meal (task?) Actually "As soon as the guest appears at the service hatch, the employee hands over his meal." That implies employee hands over after guest appears. So tasks: Guest appears at service hatch (maybe same as picks up). Employee hands over meal. Then end.

If No: Employee calls guest after 5 minutes (task) possibly repeated: we need a loop that goes back to waiting for guest to pick up. So after call, loop back to same exclusive gateway.

Also need end event for case when guest never reacts? Not defined; we can end after successful pick up. That's fine.

We need lanes: Guest lane: tasks performed by guest: "Enter restaurant", "Choose dish", "Wait for turn", "Place order", "Pick up meal", "Eat meal". Employee lane: "Enter order into POS", "Collect money", "Set up buzzer and give to guest", "Inform chef", "Set off buzzer", "Hand over meal", "Call guest". Chef lane: "Prepare meal", "Place meal in service hatch", "Inform employee". POS system lane: "POS system" maybe not needed as separate lane; we could put the POS task in employee lane, but it's entering order into POS system – perhaps the system is an object, not lane. Requirement: one lane for each actor (person, role, department or system) that performs activities. Since POS system is used but the employee performs the action, it's not a separate actor. So lanes: Guest, Employee, Chef.

Now model with exclusive gateway for reaction; need a parallel gateway? Not parallel. All sequential.

We need start event in Guest lane? Start event belongs to the process, can be placed in Guest lane (flowNodeRef). End events maybe in Guest lane? We can put end events in Guest lane.

Define ids: use step numbers? Not required because description has no numbers. So we can just name. But requirement earlier: element names start with step number if steps provided; not needed.

We need to ensure each flow node is referenced in a lane.

We'll create bpmn:definitions with one participant "Restaurant" and process id "RestaurantProcess". Lanes: laneGuest, laneEmployee, laneChef.

Now list tasks with ids.

Sequence flow IDs.

Exclusive gateway id "gw_guest_react". Use outgoing flows: yes (guest reacts) and no (no reaction). Condition expression may not be needed; we can label.

Loop: after "Call guest" task, go back to the exclusive gateway.

Add end event "End_Success". Another end? Not needed.

Now produce XML. Ensure Bpmn:process isExecutable="false" (no camunda).

We need message flows? Not between pools. Single pool.
